shelter_default.description: Sofia municipal bus shelter (modular frame, flat or slightly sloped roof, glazed back and one side, integral bench, advertising module at one end)
shelter_default.back_panels: 3 glass panels + 1 side panel; ad box (backlit city-light 1.2 x 1.75 m) on the end facing the walkway where the municipality allows (2026 programme: ad module only on the right panel)
shelter_default.confidence: low (design not verified; size from OSM footprints 4.9 x 1.7 m at Iztok, 6.1 x 2.1 m at Pliska)
sources: https://spasisofia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/doklad_-programa-za-spirkonavesi.pdf (search snippet: modular anti-corrosion structures, solid opaque roof, 3 types by load)
https://www.bta.bg/bg/videos/37901 (135 new shelters on Tsarigradsko shosse among others)
